The problem this solution exists for
Corporate ventures die from process, not ideas: no capital discipline, no evidence gates, innovation theater instead of P&L.
Our approach
We run venture programs with PoC-to-MVP gates, value-validation discipline and build-buy-partner decisions — staffed with joint teams, measured on live customers, funded in tranches against evidence.
